experiments.goal: Validate semantic identity before trusting novelty or dedupe.
experiments.hypothesis: Sorted token sets may erase causal direction, temporal order, multiplicity and entity roles; IDs may falsely merge distinct mechanisms.
experiments.probe: Call existing exports with paired mechanisms: A funds B vs B funds A; verify before delivery vs verify after delivery; payer refunds seller vs seller refunds payer. Also include genuine paraphrases. Keep original provenance and role bindings.
experiments.acceptance: Directionally distinct relations must remain distinguishable; equivalent phrasing should dedupe where equivalence is justified. Unknown equivalence remains unresolved. If failure reproduced, propose smallest typed relation/ordering fix at existing seam; do not call a sorted-word hash a causal model.
experiments.kill: If canonical mechanism identity already preserves each tested distinction through another layer, record verified reuse and close without code.
experiments.budget: One focused harness, no model calls required.

experiments.goal: Make experiment feasibility an enforceable contract.
experiments.hypothesis: Selected probe cost/time may exceed top-level ceilings, and caller-declared discriminating=true is not evidence of actual discrimination.
experiments.probe: Zero ceiling with positive-cost probe; probe time above ceiling; malformed effect counts; a probe giving identical observations under rival hypotheses. Separate syntactic checks from semantic discrimination.
experiments.acceptance: Over-budget or malformed plans refuse rather than silently normalize to safe. The chosen probe's declared effects bind its authority check. A discrimination declaration is labelled unverified until a concrete predicted outcome difference is shown. Execution permission cannot arise from descriptive prose.
experiments.kill: If downstream admission already enforces exact probe limits and effect identity, exercise that path and reuse it; avoid duplicate permission layers.
experiments.budget: One focused fake-only harness; real probes require separate applicable authority.

experiments.goal: Prove cross-domain learning rather than a larger feature catalog.
experiments.source: Existing GENESIS, Wallbreaker and Capability Genome; resolve and claim exact seams before editing.
experiments.hypothesis: A reusable mechanism distilled from one observed failure can improve held-out tasks in different domains without more compute.
experiments.probe: Freeze a development set and evaluator-held-out task families spanning software recovery, evidence reconciliation, resource planning and causal reasoning. Compare identical base model/tools with: no new mechanism, existing mechanism, candidate mechanism. Hold tokens/tool budgets constant; log route and actual cost.
experiments.acceptance: Predeclare task-level success and meaningful improvement threshold before candidate sees holdouts. Report each family's paired outcomes and uncertainty, cost, latency, abstentions and regressions. A small smoke panel is feasibility only. No generality claim from one family or a synthetic aggregate.
experiments.kill: Stop if gain disappears against the unchanged-model control or when extra compute is removed; preserve null results.
experiments.budget: Cheap model on development cases first; one candidate at a time; no frontier-model tournament by default.

experiments.source: Existing evaluator/adversary and forecast provenance paths; src/forecast-adversarial-ensemble.mjs is a donor to inspect.
experiments.hypothesis: Generator/evaluator shared ancestry or repeated holdout reuse can manufacture apparent improvement.
experiments.probe: Keep holdout answers outside generator context and editable worktree; track exposure and dataset versions. Test correlated copies, misleading high-confidence answers and evaluator blind spots. Reused holdout becomes development data.
experiments.acceptance: Candidate cannot edit its acceptance standard or promote itself. Duplicated upstream evidence does not count as independent support. Independent executable checks outrank another model vote; unavailable isolation is explicitly EVALUATION_LIMITED.
experiments.kill: Do not build model councils unless they find incremental independently verified errors within the same budget.
experiments.budget: Deterministic checks first; different model label alone is not independence.

experiments.goal: Improve tool use and reasoning without eroding earlier capability.
experiments.source: Existing capability admission/promotion/revocation; no new self-modification bypass.
experiments.hypothesis: A promoted reusable skill can retain its benefit after a context reset and preserve earlier tasks.
experiments.probe: Save the minimum mechanism plus applicability conditions, counterexamples, provenance and rollback pointer. Rehydrate in a fresh authorized session with a cheaper worker; run held-out transfer and old-task regression panels. Revoke the candidate and prove selection stops.
experiments.acceptance: Replayable improvement receipt bound to model/tool/code revisions and evaluation version; no old-task harm beyond predeclared tolerance; sensitive authority gates have zero tolerated regression. Unproven memory remains a hypothesis. No autonomous production promotion.
experiments.kill: Reject if benefit depends on hidden chat context, evaluator leakage, relaxed gates or forgotten prior capabilities.
experiments.budget: One fresh-context replay, one regression panel; broader run only to resolve a concrete remaining risk.

experiments.goal: Allocate reasoning to the next useful observation, not repeated internal discussion.
experiments.source: Existing bounded experiments, forecast decision boundary and calibration ledger.
experiments.hypothesis: An uncertainty-aware action/observe/defer policy reduces real cost per correct bounded decision.
experiments.probe: Under fixed budget compare answer-now, one discriminating observation, and defer. Preserve prediction before observation; use authorized non-sensitive cases with objectively scoreable outcomes. Separate value of information from verbal confidence.
experiments.acceptance: Report decision quality and cost at matched coverage; count abstentions and missed useful actions. Observation only selected when it can change a decision and fits authority/budget. Small-sample outcomes do not certify real-world life benefits.
experiments.kill: Stop if additional reasoning/observation cannot beat the cheap baseline after its cost, or if no discriminating lawful observation exists.

mechanisms.name: Outcome-first dependency compression
mechanisms.instruction: For one existing packet, state observable completion and build a small AND/OR prerequisite graph: all-required vs alternative routes, verified vs unknown edges, authority and resource bounds. Identify shared prerequisites blocking several valuable outcomes. Prefer the cheapest admissible route, not a single lowest skill score or greatest raw graph fanout.
mechanisms.falsifier: Removing the supposed blocker does not advance the intended outcome, or an already feasible cheaper route exists.
mechanisms.deliverable: Bounded graph/receipt inside the existing packet; no new framework or global graph migration.

mechanisms.name: Assumption-directed strategy change
mechanisms.instruction: After failure, isolate the exact assumption contradicted by evidence. Consider reuse, smaller decomposition, different supported provider/substrate, different capability bundle, or explicit stop. Preserve the objective and hard constraints. Choose one materially different route only when its prerequisites are available.
mechanisms.falsifier: New strategy changes only wording, repeats the same failure conditions or expands authority.
mechanisms.deliverable: One blocker fingerprint, failed assumption, selected alternative and disconfirming test.

mechanisms.name: Smallest useful observation
mechanisms.instruction: Ask which lawful observation could change the next decision. Run deterministic checks first, then bounded experiments under existing authority. Separate absence of evidence from impossibility. Where outcomes are not discriminating, stop buying more thought.
mechanisms.falsifier: Both rival explanations predict the same observation, or probe cost exceeds the benefit it could plausibly affect.
mechanisms.deliverable: Two rival hypotheses, predicted differences, cost ceiling and next action for either result.

mechanisms.name: Proof reuse with explicit limits
mechanisms.instruction: Bind receipts to source/dependencies/configuration/model/evaluator versions and scope. A fix or capability is reusable only when required assumptions still match. Changed hashes trigger affected-proof review; identical blobs alone do not prove integrated runtime. Do not re-run unrelated tests without a concrete risk or gate.
mechanisms.falsifier: Reused proof depends on stale environment, hidden context, different caller semantics or exposed holdout.
mechanisms.deliverable: Applicability conditions and evidence dependencies, not an unqualified VERIFIED label.

mechanisms.name: Failure becomes a regression case
mechanisms.instruction: Persist the minimal counterexample, failure class and scope. Reuse it in relevant cheap-worker acceptance tests. A successful repair becomes a candidate reusable mechanism, then follows C03 transfer/evaluator/retention gates before broader promotion.
mechanisms.falsifier: It only passes its own training example, worsens existing behavior or requires relaxing the acceptance standard.
mechanisms.deliverable: Counterexample -> bounded repair -> independent proof -> conditional reuse; no automatic production promotion.

mechanisms.name: Compute buys a specific uncertainty reduction
mechanisms.instruction: Route deterministic work without models where possible. Use cheapest configured capable model for remaining bounded work; escalate only with a minimal counterexample and a question a stronger model can resolve. Never send all checkpoint history by default.
mechanisms.falsifier: Extra tokens, agents or model strength produce no independently measured incremental benefit.
mechanisms.deliverable: Actual model/cost where observable, uncertainty before/after and stop reason; unknown budget remains unknown.

mechanisms.name: Restartable work, not chat dependence
mechanisms.instruction: Persist exact refs, owner acknowledgement, occurrence identity, pending effects, evidence, next single action and claim expiry before context loss. Resume by refreshing relevant differences. If a prior external effect is uncertain, reconcile it before retry. No durable storage receipt means no durability claim.
mechanisms.falsifier: Fresh session needs hidden conversation, duplicates an effect or mistakes a proposed owner for a running worker.
mechanisms.deliverable: Small checkpoint linked from CURRENT_HANDOFF; secrets and personal payloads excluded.

After a repair is authorized and proven, apply C03 matched-budget transfer/retention gates before claiming a general improvement. C04 lived probes require explicit private participation.

Update affected canonical evidence, integrate appropriate changes, checkpoint and continue dependency-satisfied work in the execution session. Finish with exact unresolved gates, not a whole-system percentage.

Health distinguishes process alive, database ready and useful workload ready. Liveness checks must not restart-loop merely because an external provider is unavailable.

acceptance: Persist schedule identity, scheduled-for time, next due time and bounded missed-run policy. Restart covers intended backlog without a catch-up storm.
Transactional claim/uniqueness and leases prevent concurrent dispatch of the same logical occurrence; expired lease recovery is tested.
Business timezone/DST semantics, clock skew and manual-trigger idempotency explicit; schedule edits cannot silently resurrect old effects.
Effectful jobs keep their own authority gates. At-least-once processing plus provider idempotency/reconciliation is not called universal exactly-once.
contracts.receipt: Duplicate wake + concurrent scheduler + crash-before/after-enqueue matrix with expected job identities.

acceptance: Drain new work, persist/checkpoint leases, terminate, restart and reconcile unfinished work; crash during an uncertain external effect does not blindly retry.
Encrypted backup with protected restore credentials stored outside the app failure domain; restore rehearsal required, not just backup creation.
Predeclare recovery time and maximum tolerable data loss for this host, measure both. Scope targets as operator choices, not invented guarantees.
Schema evolution supports previous app during rollback or has an explicit forward-repair/data-restore plan. Never blindly roll back an incompatible database.
An independently recoverable host supervisor or authorized controller can restart the app; controller failure has a documented minimal recovery path.
contracts.receipt: Kill/restart + backup/restore + incompatible-schema refusal + measured recovery intervals, named source/data versions.

acceptance: Reconcile desired admitted release against observed image/config/state. No speculative rebuild every tick.
Preflight -> candidate start -> migrate under verified policy -> auth and bounded workload smoke -> route switch -> observe -> retain rollback.
Bad auth, migration, persistence or workload health blocks promotion or triggers safe rollback; limit failed rollout attempts and open a circuit breaker.
No app permission to approve its own patch, widen access, change secrets or spend. Controller authority remains scoped and separately verifiable.
DEPLOY-08 only closes when a named authorized alternate host serves restored state and a bounded workload; local rehearsal stays local evidence.
contracts.receipt: Actual deployment state transitions tied to immutable release; simulation clearly labelled.

acceptance: Reuse existing event/queue/admission/continuation machinery for intent -> dedupe -> authorize -> execute -> verify -> reconcile -> checkpoint.
Inventory each existing workflow trigger, owner, data/effects, budget, idempotency, retry/compensation, evidence and escalation boundary.
Prioritize backup verification, provider health, stalled-job recovery, bounded maintenance and receipt compilation. Customer/payment/private-life effects retain separate authority.
New evidence wakes a blocked strategy; read-only observation of a bound task does not create another task. Unknown effect outcomes require reconciliation.
